title: Amazing bridges
text: Guide and driver we're lovely. Romba has gorgeous scenery and a lovrely old town. I would try to get there in the morning before it gets too hot
author: Angela_M

title: Tanya was amazing! Great job and well done giving us a great tour!
text: Our Ronda tour with Tanya was fantastic. She expertly covered all the sights while keeping our two lively boys engaged with fun, kid-friendly stories and perfect pacing. Safe, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable, Tanya made the day effortless and unforgettable. Highly, highly recommended!
author: Bhavdeep_S

title: An unforgettable day from Granada to Ronda
text:
Our trip from Granada to Ronda was perfectly planned, the minivan was spotless and comfortable, and our driver-guide, Gonzalo, was amazing - friendly and passionate about sharing the beautiful Spain. The highlight of the trip was the spot where he took us to see the breathtaking view of Puente Nuevo - absolutely stunning!
Ronda is truly amazing, with incredible views in every direction. Our local guide, Tania, was fantastic - full of stories and fun facts that really brought the history of the city to life.

title: Excellent full day walk
text: I made a trip from Malaga. We went first to Setenil de las Bodegas and then to Ronda. From the bus we saw last time several "white villages". In Setenil we stayed just over an hour which is enough to walk the pleasant place built between mountain slopes. Very interesting to travel but obviously uncomfortable for permanent housing. Then to Ronda where we were released for about four hours. Excellent proposal for everyone to go or stop at the interesting places. author: annerW3254UO

title: Fantastic Tour with Dascha and Carlos!
text:
This was an awesome tour, we were staying in Granada so it was a 2.5hr drive but we had a great driver - Carlos - who told local history on the way. 
In Ronda, the walking tour hit the highlights, lots of time for great pictures and a little shopping and lunch and Dascha was a great guide. It is an amazingly beautiful city with beautiful views over the area.
author: Phillipa_S

title: Excellent attention and professionalism.
text:
The experience from the start was excellent. It started on time, and all the staff are very attentive and friendly. 
Our driver Gonzalo is a super nice person and took us to visit areas with amazing views that would have been difficult to have otherwise. He explained in detail every important point we were going through and finally, he surprised us by buying some traditional sweets from the place.

author: Paul_S

title: Ronda is worth visiting!
text:
Gonsalo was a wonderful driver and tour guide! He made the trip very well worth it!
We really enjoyed talking with Gonsalo to and from Ronda. We also had a walking tour, despite a little mixup at the start of that tour, Tonya had a lot of enthusiasm for Ronda which was obvious & showed us some amazing views! Lastly, there was some free time to explore Ronda & to have lunch but another hour of free time would have been nice.
author: Steve S

title: Well coordinated and insightful tour of beautiful Ronda
text: A smooth and comfort transfer from the Discovering Spain office to the meeting point and then 2 hour drive to Ronda and then back to Granada (thanks to Fran and Gonsalvo). A wonderfully insightful and comfortable 1.5 hour walking tour of Ronda (thanks to Jema). We had enough time to visit the beautiful bullring also.
